ns2:section.sectionText: [Expanded title: Seminar in Archives and Records Management: Encoded Archival Description (EAD)). A WISE course; permission to enroll is initiated through Assistant Dean Rae Montague (rae@illinois.edu). Limited seats. Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. Meets 1/25/12 - 5/15/12. Mostly asynchronous; the class has one required synchronous meeting with optional monthly meetings thereafter. Course Tool: Desire2Learn. San Jose State University.
